2177.name: Getschman, Lyle
2177.note: The image shows a separate embanked pond beside the river; the river channel bends around it. DNR explicitly describes the restored Baraboo as free-flowing.

1756.name: Zinkle, A.P.
1756.note: The mapped point is in an open Wisconsin River channel; the record describes an earth wetland/cranberry structure. DNR explicitly describes this entire reach below Prairie du Sac as free-flowing.

1371.name: Ozaukee County Park
1371.note: The full record identifies a small farm pond; the image shows an open river at the supplied point. The county-endorsed water-trail map shows the through reach without this dam.

2048.name: Albright, John
2048.note: The full record identifies a small farm pond / drainage swale, not a river-spanning dam. The open river in imagery and county-endorsed water-trail map corroborate the through reach. The actual Grafton dam is retained separately.

2834.name: Ligler, Wayne
2834.note: The full record identifies a farm pond; its coordinate is on the open Trego flowage. NPS identifies the actual Trego dam downstream and its right-bank portage; that barrier is retained.

6251.name: Bay Lakes Council Boy Scouts
6251.note: The image clearly places this dam on a separate small pond beside the Wolf, with the river channel outside the impoundment. Proximity alone incorrectly attached this pond dam to the float.

1884.name: Miles, Richard
1884.note: The record describes an earth cranberry/wetland structure; imagery shows an open sandy Black River channel at the assigned point. DNR describes the downstream paddling corridor and public landings. No route line is approved by this correction alone.

2997.name: Frye, T E
2997.note: The wetland/cranberry earth-structure record corresponds to impounded wetland beside an open South Fork channel; the supplied point is in the river. Agency paddling information supports the through river corridor.

2157.name: McCluskey, Stephan S
2157.note: The full record describes a small farm pond and imagery shows an open river at its assigned coordinate. The separate Indianford dam remains unresolved; this correction does not release that section.

2561.name: Evenson, Bryon
2561.note: Agency record identifies NO WATERWAY and a small farm pond. Imagery shows the separate pond inland from the Black River; it does not cross this route.

3964.name: Twin Lakes
3964.note: Agency full record classifies Twin Lakes as a levee with zero hydraulic height, not an impounding barrier. Imagery shows the open Red Cedar bend and banks; the county paddling guide describes this reach. Rocky shallows remain a normal river hazard.
